text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["df['ct_srv_src'] <= df['ct_src_ltm']"],"features":["ct_srv_src","ct_src_ltm"],"rationale":"Connections matching both source and service are a subset of connections matching the source."},{"id":"R2","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["df['ct_srv_dst'] <= df['ct_dst_ltm']"],"features":["ct_srv_dst","ct_dst_ltm"],"rationale":"Connections matching both destination and service are a subset of connections matching the destination."},{"id":"R3","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["df['ct_src_dport_ltm'] <= df['ct_src_ltm']"],"features":["ct_src_dport_ltm","ct_src_ltm"],"rationale":"Connections matching both source and destination port are a subset of connections matching the source."},{"id":"R4","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["df['ct_dst_sport_ltm'] <= df['ct_dst_ltm']"],"features":["ct_dst_sport_ltm","ct_dst_ltm"],"rationale":"Connections matching both destination and source port are a subset of connections matching the destination."},{"id":"R5","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['ct_dst_src_ltm'] <= df['ct_dst_ltm']) & (df['ct_dst_src_ltm'] <= df['ct_src_ltm'])"],"features":["ct_dst_src_ltm","ct_dst_ltm","ct_src_ltm"],"rationale":"Connections matching a particular source-destination pair are a subset of connections matching either endpoint individually."}]}
